children: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has taken an early lead over Senator Flavio Bolsonaro in Sunday's presidential runoff election, official results show.

With 5.02% of ballots tallied, the leftist incumbent had 51.16% of the valid votes - which exclude blank and null ballots - against the right-wing challenger's 48.84%, according to Brazil's electoral authority.
